definition: Sanja Fidler is a Slovenian-Canadian computer scientist.
details: She is an associate professor at the University of Toronto Mississauga and vice-president of artificial intelligence research at Nvidia, leading Nvidia's Spatial Intelligence Lab. She is also a co-founder of the Vector Institute and CIFAR AI Chair. Her research is in the areas of computer vision and artificial intelligence.

explainer.lead: Sanja Fidler is a Slovenian-Canadian computer vision researcher. Her work spans computer vision.

timeline.what: Fidler was born in Slovenia and attended the University of Ljubljana, where she received a BSc in Applied Mathematics in 2002 and a Ph.D. in Computer Science in 2010.

She became an assistant professor at U of T's St. George campus in 2014 before joining the Department of Mathematical and Computational Sciences at its Mississauga campus in 2016, where she has held the role of associate professor since 2020.
She was vice-president of AI research at Nvidia from 2022 to 2026.
